name: io.github.b070nd/cvewatch
title: cvewatch
description: Which of your projects and environments are exposed to which CVE, who owns the fix, what happened

packageArguments.description: runs the MCP server on stdin and stdout; it is read-only unless -allow-write is added

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: token for the GitHub advisory feed, no scopes needed; without it GitHub allows 60 requests an hour

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Slack webhook that refresh sends alerts to; without it no alert is sent

environmentVariables.name: CVEWATCH_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: the name recorded in the audit log for changes made through the server
